learning.why: the teacher asked me to contrast x-t and v-t flat lines, and then tested the 'graph as picture' idea directly with Sneha's wrong statement -- correcting her made it click

end.summary:
Read v-t graph slope as acceleration; four unaided correct attempts.
Used area under v-t graph to find displacement/distance in numerical examples.
Interpreted flat x-t and v-t graphs correctly.
Explained that graph lines describe motion, not the physical path.
Teach-back was not passed; repeated explanations were given for slope and motion stories.
end.parentNote: Asha practised reading position-time and velocity-time graphs, including slope, area, and motion stories. Ira correctly used v-t slope for acceleration and graph area for displacement, and explained that an x-t graph is not a picture of a road or hill. They repeated the motion-story explanation later, though the final teach-back was not passed. At home, ask Ira to describe one x-t graph and one v-t graph in words before calculating anything.
